around midnight, my mind and body became incredibly restless. My spirit kept telling me that someone had entered this house.

In the morning, my husband went to work. I had told the Mother, "Mother, please wake me up at 5:30," because I didn't have a phone with me back then.
I had to rely on looking at the clock to wake up. I begged the Mother, "You must wake me up at 5:30.

sounding exactly like my mummy calling me. I jolted awake, still groggy from sleep. I suddenly got up and looked around.
Was it my mummy? No, my mummy wasn't here. My hometown is Erumely, so it wasn't my mummy. Then I realized, it was the Blessed Mother!
The Mother came to me with my mummy's voice. When I looked at the time, it was exactly ten minutes to 5:30. I got up,
and as I lit the candle to begin my prayers, the Mother told me, "Open the door, open the door."
She kept saying it. When I opened the door, there was an overwhelming, powerful fragrance of jasmine. I don't have a single plant in my house.
Even if there were a jasmine plant, it wouldn't be blooming; there are no flowers around. But there was a strong scent of jasmine. I searched the entire porch,

that when the Blessed Mother comes, you will experience the sweet fragrance of jasmine. I immediately ran back to the Mother and asked,
"Mother, did you come to my home?" That was all I asked. At that exact moment, the fragrance vanished. After that, I started my prayers.
My husband initially had a very small job. He was working in the Milma milk field.
Since the age of 18, the milk field has been the work he finds easiest and loves the most.
So when I first made the Covenant, my very first intercession was, "Mother, please grant my husband a job in that field."
Exactly one week after taking the Covenant and praying for this, my husband's friend called and offered him a job as a driver in that very same milk field.
That was the very first blessing the Mother granted us. Then we continued our prayers fervently. We kept praying, and one day during prayer,
the Mother appeared to me in the very form of this statue, glowing within the green candle.
Even then, the Mother told me, "I am with you. Do not be afraid. No matter what comes your way, you must not shed a tear."
In my heart, I responded, "I am praying in the best way I know how. I am joyfully accepting all the sufferings you are sending me."
While things were like this, last October, the hemoglobin (HB) level in my blood dropped drastically. Everyone normally needs an HB of 12 to 13,
but mine was steadily dropping to 9 and 8. It was a time of continuous physical decline, but I held firmly onto my prayers.
I was completely exhausted. We were running so many medical tests. And all those tests were costing four thousands of rupees. So, I would tell the Mother,
"Mother, my husband has to manage all of this completely on his own. Whatever suffering you give me, I will accept it with both hands, but please do not burden my husband."
We did the final medical test, and when the results came out, we forwarded them to a cousin sister of ours.
When she saw the results, she said, "This is quite critical, Chippy. You must immediately either go to the Medical College,
or to a nearby private hospital." But if we went to a private hospital,
a single blood injection would cost over four thousand rupees. We simply couldn't afford that.
So, my husband and I made a firm decision. My husband got a bit scared and said, "You should go to the Medical College.
Let's get tested there, whatever happens, let it happen." I cried and prayed to the Blessed Mother, "Mother,
you are the one who must go before me, no one else. We have no one but you, Mother," I pleaded with her.
The day before we were to go to the Medical College, we got all the tests done at a nearby hospital. Carrying those results and preparing for the Medical College,
On the way, we saw a woman who looked exactly like the statue of the Blessed Mother. She had the exact same height,
a covering over her head, and she was carrying a small child. When this woman saw us approaching, she was smiling beautifully.
She looked like someone begging for alms. But she was smiling brightly. There was no sorrow on her face, only a divine smile.
My husband and I were riding our bike. We smiled back. As we moved a little forward, my husband himself suggested it.
We had bought some snacks for our kids and were holding ice cream in our hands.
My husband said, "Hey, didn't you see that woman and her child walking by? Let's give an ice cream to that little child."
Before this happened, during the time my blood levels were dropping, both of my hands had developed severe white patches.
These white patches were terrible; anyone who saw them would be deeply concerned. Because of these patches, both my hands would itch uncontrollably.
Whenever sunlight hit them, they would itch, crack open, and bleed. I couldn't bear the pain; it was that difficult.
I was going about my life bearing this terrible condition. Seeing this woman, we turned our bike around to offer an ice cream to the child.
As we did, the woman and the child turned towards us,
smiling continuously. I thought to myself, "What is this? People who come begging for alms usually don't smile like this, do they?
They usually ask with sorrow, not a smile." Looking at that woman's smile, I could instantly feel a great divine presence radiating from her.
I stepped down from the bike, and the moment I did, the woman gently rubbed her hand down my arm and shoulder. At that exact second, a powerful shock like lightning coursed through my hand!
I couldn't understand anything. I wondered, "Why did she suddenly come and touch my hand?" Usually, beggars keep a distance,
don't they? But she came right up to me and touched me. And the little child was gazing intently into my eyes. The color of the clothes
the child was wearing was the exact deep blue color of the candle we light during our 5:30 AM prayers! The child just kept staring at me.
I handed over the ice cream. Then I asked my husband, "Do you have any money on you?" She mentioned they hadn't received anything that day.
My husband took some money and gave it to her, and showed them the way. We got back on the bike, and until we rode completely out of sight,
the child kept turning back and staring right at me. By the time evening fell, I called everyone and joyfully declared,
"The Blessed Mother and Jesus came to see me!" I told my husband, and I testified to my whole family, "The Blessed Mother came to visit me.
I am absolutely certain that my illness will be cured." The very next day, we were on our way to the Medical College. My eldest daughter and I boarded a bus.
The bus was fully packed; there was no place to sit at all. While I was standing there tightly holding my child's hand, right opposite to me sat a woman.
She was wearing a white dress with green floral patterns. At first, I didn't pay much attention.
But this woman gently pulled my child into a warm embrace. She hugged her and told me, "Dear, I am traveling up to Kottayam.
Let the child sit comfortably on my lap." She seated my little girl on her lap, rested her head, and put her to sleep.
I was holding my Holy Rosary tight in my hand at that moment. I was interceding fervently, "Mother, please go before me and take care of everything."
We sat in the bus and finally reached Kottayam. The woman got down. As she was leaving, she simply said, "I am going now." That was all she said.
I smiled, and that sister also smiled. As soon as we reached the hospital, there was no rush. Very quickly, I was able to see the doctors.
At that time, I didn't feel any exhaustion at all. The doctor was a lady doctor wearing a silver-grey churidar.
When she spoke to me, I wasn't really paying attention, but that doctor told me,
"Dear child, you only need to do these tests when you have the money. For now, just take this medicine." So I remembered,
there were 18 tests to be done. 18 tests would cost nearly six thousand rupees! So I said, "Alright, doctor, I will do that."
Everyone knows that medicines prescribed at Kottayam Medical College are only available in the nearby medical stores.
But that day, I didn't even buy that medicine. I went home without buying it.
I didn't take any medicine either. Up until this very moment, that illness has never returned! I don't know what happened, but from the moment that Mother, that sister,
came near me, my illness was completely cured. Later, the Blessed Mother appeared to me in the form of a dove.
When my child had a fever, I was on my way to a nearby government hospital. At that time, I told the Blessed Mother—whenever I go anywhere,
I say, "Mother, you must go before me and take care of everything. Only then will I come.
I don't have the strength to do it myself, so you must go." Wherever I go, I always pray the Holy Rosary along the way.
I asked the Mother, "Mother, I need to know if you are truly with me. You must give me a sign."
As I was walking forward, continuously praying the Holy Rosary, after about half an hour of walking, a dove in the Mother's colors—silver grey—came right in front of me.
The dove looked right at me, and then gracefully soared up into the sky.
In that moment, the only thought that echoed in my heart was her word: "I am with you, do not be afraid, keep walking forward."
Just like that, she appeared as a flower in the candle flame, and she blessed me with the sweet fragrance of jasmine.

we had asked many people for help because my husband had met with an accident and was jobless at the time.

we try to help others financially in whatever small way we can.

this is the promise of God in the lives of the Covenant children.
